opening.argument: The segment is centered on practical employment guidance for pursuing a job at Goldman Sachs. Its title directly asks how to get that job, while the discussion covers relevant college majors, resilience and failure, honesty, authenticity, and work-life balance. The advice describes interview preparation and workplace expectations, including that “failure is a big part of getting to understand how someone operates and what motivates them” and that asking about work-life balance is “a very thoughtful question to ask.” Nothing in this material presents a financial product, investment opportunity, payment request, private credentials, or other financial action. The apparent purpose therefore remains career education, despite the closing dollar imagery.
